question: Among patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests in 1984 and are under 50 years old at the time of testing, find the one with the most abnormal Ig M level (furthest from the normal range of 40–400). Return their ID, sex, and whether their uric acid was abnormal for their sex.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    CASE
        WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'M' AND L."XCL_022" > 8.0 THEN 'abnormal'
        WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND L."XCL_022" > 6.5 THEN 'abnormal'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END AS uric_acid_abnormal
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE E."XCL_008" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_015" LIKE '1984%'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) < 50
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN L."XCL_044" < 40 THEN 40 - L."XCL_044"
        WHEN L."XCL_044" > 400 THEN L."XCL_044" - 400
        ELSE 0
    END DESC
LIMIT 1

    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    CASE
        WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'M' AND L."XCL_022" > 8.0 THEN 'abnormal'
        WHEN P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND L."XCL_022" > 6.5 THEN 'abnormal'

FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"

        WHEN L."XCL_044" < 40 THEN 40 - L."XCL_044"
        WHEN L."XCL_044" > 400 THEN L."XCL_044" - 400
        ELSE 0
    END DESC
LIMIT 1
